manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield immediately.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its last ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
